title: Only a fraction of World Heritage sites are in Africa. China wants to fix that
text:
Only a fraction of World Heritage sites are in Africa. China wants to fix that | South China Morning Post Diplomacy - Diplomacy Only a fraction of World Heritage sites are in Africa. China wants to fix that 4 Advertisement China-Africa relations China Diplomacy Only a fraction of World Heritage sites are in Africa. China wants to fix that 
 Beijing is offering funds and training to help nations win Unesco listings, a move analysts say boosts its soft power
 3 -MIN READ 3 -MIN 4 Listen Jevans Nyabiage Published: 12:00pm, 8 Nov 2026 Africa is home to ancient cities, rock art and striking natural landscapes, yet its sites are sorely under-represented on Unesco’s World Heritage List.
 According to data released by the UN body, of the 1,273 sites on the list – which are formally protected under the World Heritage Convention treaty – just 115 are in Africa.
 But as Beijing seeks closer cultural ties with the continent , it is offering help to change this through funding, guidance on how to navigate the nomination process and training in conservation.
